mapper.sql: id, user_id, message_count, summary, status, summary_order, activity_time, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session (user_id, message_count, summary, status, summary_order, activity_time, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{messageCount}, #{summary}, #{status}, #{summaryOrder}, #{activityTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY activity_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET user_id = #{userId}, message_count = #{messageCount}, summary = #{summary}, status = #{status}, summary_order = #{summaryOrder}, activity_time = #{activityTime}, create_time = #{createTime} WHERE id = #{id}
